scheme_name: Pension Scheme for the Tappers in Small Rubber Plantations
other_conditions: Must have at least 90 days of tapping experience in the preceding 12 months.
Must be engaged in tapping jobs throughout the year in small rubber plantations for wages or self‑tapping in own plantation up to 1 hectare.
Must be certified under Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL) of PMKVY or have completed training by the Rubber Board (e.g., TSS, TISP).
Must be enrolled in the tapper bank under Rubber Producers Societies (RPS).
Not eligible if already a member of any Central/State government pension scheme.
Not eligible if tapping in rubber plantation larger than 5 hectares.
Must regularly remit the annual contribution on time to receive the Board’s 50 % matching for the initial 5 years.
benefits_summary: Pension of ₹1300 per month after age 60, along with family pension, disability, maternity, and medical assistance benefits.
documents_required: Duly filled application form countersigned by the employer/RPS President/Field Officer
Forwarding letter showing applicant details (Name, Address, Age, Category, UTR No.)
application_link: Step 1: Submit a duly filled application form countersigned by the employer/RPS President/Field Officer along with all relevant documents. Step 2: Supply the application forms to the Regional Offices of the Labour Welfare Division. Step 3: Forward hard copies of original application forms and documents to Labour Welfare Division, Kottayam with a forwarding letter containing applicant details.
